outcomes.outcome: INPUT and FORWARD drop by default; the Hiera whitelist and the acl reach SSH unlimited
traffic to 127.0.0.0/8 arriving on another interface is rejected (rule 002)

uncovered.why: measured on the applied node: 3 hand-built Ethernet frames from the peer to 127.0.0.1 through the node's NIC were counted 0 by rule 002, as route_localnet is 0 on the node and the kernel drops such a destination before INPUT; no check can show rule 002 act (a lead in escalations/firewall_secure_extra.behaviour.md)

outcomes.outcome: SSH from a host on no list is limited against brute force (overall 20 a minute with a burst of 5, 8 held per host, 15 new a minute per host)
invalid packets (bogus flag combinations such as SYN+FIN, out-of-connection RSTs) and new packets without SYN are dropped before routing
SYN packets with an MSS outside 536-65535 are dropped (rule 503), while a normal MSS connects
ICMP echo requests are limited to 2 per second
RST packets above 2 a second (burst 2) are dropped
only whitelisted sources reach the listed service, through the side chain
a whitelisted source holds at most ddos_limit connections to the service and opens new ones at the limited rate
a blacklisted source is dropped outright, SSH and ICMP included
rules Puppet does not manage are purged at the next agent run
the flush script the WARNING asks for clears every rule, and the next agent run rebuilds the class's firewall
sources from whitelisted countries reach the services (country_whitelist, src_cc)

uncovered.why: the geoip match (xt_geoip) is not on Ubuntu 24.04 without xtables-addons and a GeoIP database, which no class installs; whether production sets country_whitelist is a production read

outcomes.outcome: unlisted sources on the service port are forwarded to an internal landing server (internal_forward)

uncovered.why: needs an internal network behind the node with a server on it; the lab's nodes share one host-only link

outcomes.outcome: with anti_ddos but without ip_filter, every source is held to the per-source connection and rate limits on the listed services in INPUT

uncovered.why: a fixture variant of the same node (one set holds one fixture); this one exercises the side-chain variant of the same limits (lines 225-250), which pass

outcomes.outcome: without anti_ddos the listed service ports are simply opened, and strict mode admits only listed SSH sources

uncovered.why: fixture variants of the same node (one set holds one fixture); this one exercises the class's DDoS and filter extras
